recipe.criteria: Chest supported on 45-degree incline bench with feet stationary. Dumbbells hang from straight arms. Elevate shoulders toward ears with slight retraction; pause and lower without elbow flexion or torso movement. 3.5 seconds lift, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds lower.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
